validation_reason: The recommendation of Azure must be validated with the customer to confirm alignment with their existing cloud subscriptions and IT infrastructure preferences.
rationale: Azure offers native integration with SharePoint runbooks and robust EU data residency guarantees through its EU Data Boundary. Its fully managed Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search services enable the 9-person platform team to operate the system without specialized ML engineering staff.

alternatives.why_not: While AWS provides strong managed AI services via Bedrock, it lacks native, out-of-the-box integration with SharePoint runbooks compared to the Microsoft ecosystem.
GCP was excluded because it does not align as closely with the customer's Microsoft-centric document repositories and was not listed as a preferred hosting platform in the initial assumptions.
